brand_dna.category: Modular, interchangeable jewelry and accessories built around a handcrafted Frame plus swappable Core stones.
brand_dna.core_belief: Be I Am - a reminder to be yourself. Jewelry that evolves with you so you can express your ever-changing, fluid uniqueness.
proof_points: Handcrafted Cores made from minerals, gems and woods
Modular system - core, frame and chain each swap out in seconds
Small, independent business based in CT
Hypoallergenic ion-plated and stainless steel, brass and .925 Sterling Silver options
brand_dna.positioning: Meaningful, high-quality, customizable jewelry for self-expression - not fast-fashion accessories, but enduring daily companions.

voice_pillars.name: Reflective and Grounding
voice_pillars.desc: Ties every product back to identity, presence and daily ritual rather than surface style.
voice_pillars.quote: More than jewelry, Beiam is about presence, self-expression, and daily ritual.

voice_pillars.name: Change-Friendly
voice_pillars.desc: Frames the product as something that adapts alongside the wearer through life's stages.

voice_pillars.name: Inclusive and Personal
voice_pillars.desc: Speaks to diverse people and hands the wearer full control over their combination.
voice_pillars.quote: compliment humans of diverse backgrounds and identities

voice_pillars.name: Craft-Confident
voice_pillars.desc: States the making and quality plainly without hype or superlatives.
voice_pillars.quote: We make Cores by hand, using a variety of materials such as minerals, gems and woods.

phrases: Swap stones in seconds to match your mood, intention, or style
match your outfit/vibe or carry a specific stone with you for their other properties
The Core Series Necklace changes with you as you change in life
It's a great companion along the way
Hundreds of combinations of Cores, metals, finishes and designs to choose from

icp: Self-aware, expressive adults who value meaning and craftsmanship, want jewelry they can customize to their mood or intention, and buy pieces meant to last and evolve with them.

personas.name: The Intentional Wearer
personas.description: Values crystals and stone meaning and daily ritual; moved by the ability to carry a specific stone with them and swap it as their intention shifts.

personas.name: The Self-Expressive Individualist
personas.description: Wants pieces that reflect a unique identity; moved by 'Be I Am' and hundreds of combinations to make it their own.

personas.name: The Gift Giver
personas.description: Buying a meaningful, lasting piece for someone who values authenticity; moved by the modular, personalize-it angle and gift credit policy.

offers: $5 flat rate shipping in the United States; free flat rate over $70 and free USPS Priority/UPS Ground over $120 (shipping policy)
Returns accepted up to 30 days after delivery if unused and in original condition
Create Your Own necklaces and keycaps (full customization)
Newsletter signup for new products and blog posts

Cores are handcrafted from minerals, gems and woods.

banned.claim: The best modular jewelry in the world / #1 modular necklace.
banned.why: FTC - unqualified superlative that cannot be substantiated.

banned.claim: Carrying this stone will heal, protect or improve your health.
banned.why: FTC substantiation - unprovable health/metaphysical benefit; keep stone 'properties' language descriptive, not a claim.
FTC - guaranteed-results claim; site only says 'last for a lifetime if cared for', so keep the qualifier.

banned.claim: Only 3 left - order in the next 10 minutes!
banned.why: Compliance - fake urgency not supported by real inventory data.

banned.claim: Rated 5 stars by hundreds of happy customers.
banned.why: FTC - invented review counts; no customer reviews were found.
FTC Green Guides - unqualified sustainability claim with no supporting evidence on site.
